title: 🤯 "I'm Good" Doesn't Mean YES! (Don't Say This) #Shorts #EnglishLearning

subtitles.en: Hey, Alex. Do you want some cookies?
Okay, I guess you are not hungry then?
subtitles.zh: 好吧，看來你現在不餓囉？

subtitles.en: Wait, I said I was good. Why didn't you give me one?
subtitles.zh: 等等，我剛剛說 I was good 耶，你怎麼沒給我？

subtitles.en: In my head, I am good meant. Yes, I feel good about eating that.
subtitles.zh: 我腦袋裡以為 I am good 是指「好啊，我想吃」耶！

subtitles.en: Big mistake. In English, I am good often mean.
subtitles.zh: 大錯特錯！在英文裡，I am good 通常是指……

subtitles.en: It is a polite way to say no.
subtitles.zh: 這其實是很有禮貌的拒絕方式。

subtitles.en: If you want it, just say…
Got it. Yes, please is the magic word.
subtitles.zh: 懂了！說 Yes, please 才是通關密語。

subtitles.en: Ready to write the next script?
subtitles.zh: 準備好寫下一支腳本了嗎？
